```{=html}
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

main.content.page-columns {

/* Ocean-themed Hero Banner */

}

/* Styled Tabset for Switching Between Graphs */
.panel-tabset .nav-tabs {

}

.panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link {

}

.panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link:hover {

}

.panel-tabset .nav-tabs .nav-link.active {

</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('a[data-bs-toggle="tab"], button[data-bs-toggle="tab"], .panel-tabset .nav-link').forEach(function(tabEl) {
    tabEl.addEventListener('shown.bs.tab', function () {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
    });
    tabEl.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setTimeout(function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 60);
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)

whale_shark_raw <- read_tsv("data/whale_shark/occurrence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)
beluga_raw <- read_tsv("data/beluga/occurrence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Prepare all 2,391 Whale Shark tracking & sighting points (Coral Sea)
whale_shark_points <- whale_shark_raw |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    shark_name = str_remove(
      coalesce(occurrenceRemarks, "Coral Sea Sighting"),
      "^Animal name:\\s*"
    ),
    track_id = coalesce(as.character(organismID), "Unmarked"),
    common_name = paste0("Whale Shark (", shark_name, ")")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  arrange(track_id, eventDate, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    total_span_months = round(total_span_days / 30.44, 1),
    months_elapsed = round(days_elapsed / 30.44, 2),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(scientificName, track_id, shark_name)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " — ID: ", track_id, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

# Prepare Beluga Whale acoustic detection points (Western Beaufort Sea)
beluga_points <- beluga_raw |>
  filter(scientificName == "Delphinapterus leucas") |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    track_id = coalesce(as.character(organismID), "Beaufort_Mooring"),
    common_name = paste0("Beluga Whale (", track_id, ")")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  arrange(track_id, eventDate, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    total_span_months = round(total_span_days / 30.44, 1),
    months_elapsed = round(days_elapsed / 30.44, 2),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(scientificName, track_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

all_occurrences <- bind_rows(
  whale_shark_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, months_elapsed, total_span_months,
      spotting_num, total_spottings, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    ),
  beluga_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, months_elapsed, total_span_months,
      spotting_num, total_spottings, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    obs_month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>Common Name: ", common_name, "</b><br>",
      "Scientific Name: <i>", scientificName, "</i><br>",
      "Organism / ID: ", label, "<br>",
      "Group: ", group, "<br>",
      "Event Date: ", date, " (", obs_month, ")<br>",
      "Spotting / Tracking #: ", spotting_num, " of ", total_spottings, "<br>",
      "Months Elapsed: ", round(months_elapsed, 1), " months (Total Span: ", total_span_months, " months)<br>",
      "Coordinates: (", round(decimalLatitude, 3), ", ", round(decimalLongitude, 3), ")"
    )
  )

shared_occurrences <- SharedData$new(all_occurrences)
```

  <h2 class="plot-card-title">Cumulative Spottings & Trackings Over Observation Span (Months Elapsed)</h2>

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = shared_occurrences,
  x = ~months_elapsed,
  y = ~spotting_num,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)" = "#38bdf8",
    "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)" = "#0f766e"
  ),
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scattergl",
  mode = "markers",
  width = "100%",
  height = 680,
  marker = list(size = 6.5, opacity = 0.72)
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
    plot_bgcolor = "#f8fafc",
    margin = list(t = 95, r = 25, b = 65, l = 70),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Observation Span Elapsed (Months Since First Sighting)</b>",
      gridcolor = "#e2e8f0",
      zerolinecolor = "#cbd5e1",
      rangemode = "nonnegative",
      minallowed = 0,
      range = c(0, 135),
      tick0 = 0,
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE, thickness = 0.08, bgcolor = "#f1f5f9", range = c(0, 135))
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Cumulative Spotting / Tracking Count</b>",
      gridcolor = "#e2e8f0",
      zerolinecolor = "#cbd5e1",
      rangemode = "nonnegative",
      minallowed = 0,
      range = c(0, 1300),
      tick0 = 0
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.12, yanchor = "bottom"),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        x = 0,
        xanchor = "left",
        y = 1.02,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        bgcolor = "#f8fafc",
        bordercolor = "#cbd5e1",
        buttons = list(
          list(
            label = "View: All Timeframes (0–132 Months)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 135),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "View: Spread Evenly (Log Scale X-Axis)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "log",
              "xaxis.autorange" = TRUE,
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: 0–14 Months (Beluga & Tagged Whale Shark Overlap)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 14),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: Tagged Whale Sharks Detail (0–14 Months, 1–450 Spottings)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 14),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 450)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: Multi-Year Whale Sharks (10–132 Months)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(10, 135),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 300)
            ))
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```

## 2. Bar Graph (Monthly Comparison & Total Spottings)

<div class="plot-card" style="margin-bottom: 1.75rem;">
<div class="plot-card-header">
  <h2 class="plot-card-title">Seasonal Activity by Calendar Month (Jan–Dec)</h2>
</div>
```{r}
monthly_summary <- all_occurrences |>
  summarize(
    monthly_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(obs_month, group)
  ) |>
  complete(
    obs_month = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE),
    group,
    fill = list(monthly_spottings = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_hover = paste0(
      "<b>Month: ", obs_month, "</b><br>",
      "Group: ", group, "<br>",
      "Total Spottings / Detections: <b>", scales::comma(monthly_spottings), "</b>"
    )
  )

plot_ly(
  data = monthly_summary,
  x = ~obs_month,
  y = ~monthly_spottings,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)" = "#38bdf8",
    "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)" = "#0f766e"
  ),
  text = ~month_hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "bar",
  width = "100%",
  height = 520
) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    autosize = TRUE,
    paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
    plot_bgcolor = "#f8fafc",
    margin = list(t = 50, r = 25, b = 70, l = 70),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Calendar Month of the Year</b>",
      gridcolor = "#e2e8f0"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "<b>Total Recorded Spottings / Detections</b>",
      gridcolor = "#e2e8f0",
      zerolinecolor = "#cbd5e1",
      rangemode = "nonnegative",
      minallowed = 0
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.04, yanchor = "bottom")
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```
</div>

<div class="plot-card">
<div class="plot-card-header">
  <h2 class="plot-card-title">Total Detections by Individual Organism (With Span in Months)</h2>

```{r}
organism_summary <- all_occurrences |>
  summarize(
    total_spottings = n(),
    total_span_months = max(total_span_months),
    first_seen = min(first_seen),
    last_seen = max(last_seen),
    .by = c(common_name, group)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_spottings)) |>
  mutate(
    common_name = fct_inorder(common_name),
    bar_hover = paste0(
      "<b>", common_name, "</b><br>",
      "Group: ", group, "<br>",
      "Total Spottings / Detections: <b>", scales::comma(total_spottings), "</b><br>",
      "Observation Span: <b>", total_span_months, " months</b> (",
      first_seen, " to ", last_seen, ")"
    )
  )

plot_ly(
  data = organism_summary,
  x = ~common_name,
  y = ~total_spottings,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)" = "#38bdf8",
    "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)" = "#0f766e"
  ),
  text = ~bar_hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "bar",
  width = "100%",
  height = 620
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,

    xaxis = list(
```
